title: Basic IOS Error Messages
description: Recognize and interpret common IOS error messages.
scenario: Recognize and interpret common IOS error messages.

objectives.text: Trigger % Invalid input with a typo
Trigger % Invalid input from the wrong mode

concepts.title: % Incomplete command
concepts.body: IOS recognised the command but you stopped halfway — it doesn't yet know what to do. Add the missing keyword and try again: "show ip" needs what to show about IP, e.g. "show ip interface brief".
concepts.code:
SW1> show ip
% Incomplete command.
SW1> show ip interface brief
Vlan1 is up, line protocol is up

concepts.title: % Invalid input detected at '^' marker
concepts.body: IOS doesn't recognise a word you typed — most often a typo. The ^ points at roughly where it gave up. Correct the spelling and press Enter again.
concepts.code:
SW1> show runnig-config
% Invalid input detected at '^' marker.
SW1> show running-config

concepts.title: % Invalid input — wrong mode
concepts.body: The same % Invalid input can also mean the command is fine but you're in the wrong mode. From user EXEC (SW1>) some commands are refused; enter privileged EXEC with enable (SW1#) and retry.
concepts.code:
SW1> show running-config
% Invalid input detected at '^' marker.
SW1> enable
SW1# show running-config
